message.content: The consensus among critics and audiences alike points to **“Parasite”** as the standout film of 2020. Directed by Bong Joon‑ho, the Korean dark‑comedy thriller not only won the Academy Award for Best Picture (making history as the first non‑English film to do so) but also swept numerous other major awards—including Best Director, Best Original Screenplay, and Best International Feature Film. Its sharp social commentary, genre‑blending storytelling, and masterful direction earned it widespread acclaim and cemented its place as the most celebrated movie of that year.
